seo.title: Landscaping services in Greater Victoria | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: Four service lines for homes, stratas and businesses in Greater Victoria: grounds maintenance, installation, irrigation and tree work. Free written quote.

lede: Four services from one local crew and one point of contact.

sections.heading: Why one contractor helps
body: When maintenance, irrigation and tree work come from one crew, a broken sprinkler or a leaning tree gets noticed and handled, not passed between trades.
